label: baseline
electricity_scope: Byproduct hydrogen is limited by the archived kg/h source availability and selected conditioning capacity in every three-hour interval; it provides no renewable electricity. DAC grid purchases cover DAC only. Hydrogen component costs include selected conditioning equipment and grid electricity; conditioning and synthesis use grid electricity, and hydrogen carbon includes the configured industrial-source upstream allocation plus conditioning electricity.
fixed_asset_scope: SAF and electrolyzer build/capacity; DAC build where present. Auxiliary inventory/transport use retains original optimization rules.
method: Full original MPS dispatch with all design integers and H2/CO2 weekly contracts fixed; every original row and original bound independently evaluated.
